create_json_dataset: create a JsonDataset instance from a registered COCO json dataset name to load annotations and categories
get_roidb_with_gt: get an roidb with ground truth boxes and annotations from a JsonDataset for training
add_proposals_to_roidb: add proposal boxes from a file to an roidb with filtering by size and crowd overlap
filter_crowd_proposals: filter proposals that overlap crowd regions above a threshold and mark them for exclusion
add_class_assignments: compute max class assignments and overlaps for each box in an roidb entry
